title: Hold Music
premise: A full symphony orchestra in a gilded hall, playing beautifully, to one telephone on a velvet chair. Somebody is on hold. The conductor will not stop until they pick up.
visual: Two thousand empty red seats. A single cherry-red telephone sitting upright on a velvet chair alone in the center stalls, receiver off the cradle and laid politely beside it, cord running away into the dark. Eighty musicians in full evening dress, mid-phrase, every stand lit. The conductor is deep into the third movement. Nobody is looking at the seats.
characterLean: Liliane is the caller and has been holding since the overture. Vivienne would have hung up and had the hall closed.
